groups.label: Colors
groups.help: Accent color, mode and custom colors

groups.label: Eigene Farben
groups.help: Farben für Hell und Dunkel einzeln einstellen. Leer = Standard des Themes. Mit Colorpicker, eigener Farbpalette und Kontrast-Warnung. Gespeichert wird immer, auch bei Warnung.

options.label: Color mode
options.help: Light, dark or follow the device. Visitors can switch in the shop.

options.label: Accent color
options.help: Color for buttons, links and highlights. All variants are contrast-checked for light and dark.

options.label: Custom accent color
options.help: Leave empty to use the accent color above. Note: custom colors are not contrast-checked automatically.

options.label: Show light/dark switch
options.help: Off = no switch in the shop. Choose below where it appears.

options.label: Place of the light/dark switch
options.help: Header = icon in the icon bar (default). Footer = row in the footer. Customer account = entry in the customer account, where the platform allows it.

options.label: Body font
options.help: All fonts are stored locally in the theme, nothing is loaded from Google.

options.label: Corners
options.help: Rounding of cards, buttons and images.

options.label: Logo (light background)
options.help: SVG or PNG, at least twice the display size for a sharp result.

options.label: Logo (dark background)
options.help: Optional. Without it the light logo is used.

options.label: Logo alternative text
options.help: Read by screen readers. Usually the shop name.

options.label: Header layout
options.help: Structure of the header area.

options.label: Announcement bar text
options.help: Only use statements you can prove (unfair competition law).

options.label: Show favorites (heart list)
options.help: Visitors can mark products with a heart. The list stays in their own browser and is not sent to the shop. The header icon appears only when at least one favorite is saved.

options.label: Show payment methods in the footer
Show trust notes
options.help: For example returns, shipping, support. Only enter statements that are true.

options.label: Trust note 1
options.help: Only enter what actually applies in the shop.

options.label: Hero area
options.help: Large introduction on the home page.

options.label: Button target (address)
options.help: Internal address such as /collections/new or a full address.

options.label: Hero image
options.help: Use your own image, no stock photos without a license.

options.label: Product list
options.help: Display in collections and search.

options.label: Note next to the price
options.help: Mandatory information (price indication rules). The link to the shipping costs always stays.

options.label: Show unit price
options.help: Mandatory where price indication rules require a unit price.

options.label: Focus outline
options.help: Visible outline for keyboard use.

options.label: Load images only when scrolled into view

options.label: Kartenstil
options.help: Wie Produktkarten und Boxen aussehen: flach, mit Rahmen oder mit Schatten.

options.label: Flächenstil
options.help: Glas: halbtransparente Flächen mit feinem Rand und Weichzeichner. Fällt bei älteren Browsern und bei der Systemeinstellung „Transparenz reduzieren“ auf einfarbige Flächen zurück.

options.label: Inhaltsbreite
options.help: Maximale Breite des Inhalts auf großen Bildschirmen.

options.label: Note on the statutory warranty
options.help: On the product page and in the cart.

options.label: Warranty text
options.help: Suggested text, have it checked legally.
options.default: Für alle Artikel gilt die gesetzliche Gewährleistung (Mängelhaftung) von mindestens zwei Jahren.

options.label: Product safety (GPSR) on the product page
options.help: Reads the product metafields gpsr.manufacturer (manufacturer), gpsr.responsible_person (responsible person in the EU), gpsr.contact (contact) and gpsr.safety_info (safety information), each multi-line text. Without values nothing appears.

options.label: Page “Withdraw from contract”
options.help: Linked in the footer. The page should contain the withdrawal form or function. The order button is labeled by Shopify checkout, not by the theme.

options.label: Sold-out products in lists
options.help: On the product page a sold-out product always stays reachable and marked, the buy button is disabled. Hiding can reduce the number per page.

options.label: Accessibility statement page
options.help: Linked in the footer.

presets.label: Standard (Anthrazit/Hell, Rot)
presets.help: Die Grundeinstellung des Themes. Setzt Farben, Ecken, Abstände, Schatten und Flächenstil zurück.

presets.label: Glas
presets.help: Halbtransparente Flächen mit feinem Rand und runden Ecken, dezente Schatten. Bleibt lesbar: Text hat auf Hintergrund und Fläche mindestens 4,5 zu 1 Kontrast.

presets.label: Kompakt
presets.help: Weniger Abstand, eckigere Ecken und breiterer Inhalt: mehr Produkte auf einen Blick.
